spec_text:
E1_I0027 CANONICAL REFERENCE LADDER v1
rungs=R0_LEAGUE|R1_PLAYER_EXPAND|R2_EWMA_TUNED|R3_RATE_X_MINUTES|R4_RICH_LOOKUP
canonical_rung=R4_RICH_LOOKUP
targets=pts|minutes|fga|ppm|reb|ast
pts: mode=composite half_life=8.0 shrink=prior_season k=0.5 floor=0.0
minutes: mode=equal half_life=2.0 shrink=none k=0.0 floor=0.0
fga: mode=equal half_life=5.0 shrink=prior_season k=0.5 floor=0.0
ppm: mode=mean_of_prior_ratios half_life=40.0 shrink=prior_season k=2.0 floor=0.0
reb: mode=equal half_life=5.0 shrink=prior_season k=0.5 floor=0.0
ast: mode=equal half_life=8.0 shrink=prior_season k=0.5 floor=0.0
r4_features=intercept|R0|R1|R2|R3(if defined)|prior_minutes_ewma|prior_rate_ewma|prior_season_player|log1p_n_prior
r4_fit=OLS on seasons strictly earlier than the scored season
denominator=SST of the response on the FULL scored row set, unweighted mean

reb.source: selected in E1_I0027 on train seasons [2021, 2022] only, D094's grid, mode/shrinkage adopted from D094 unchanged

ast.source: selected in E1_I0027 on train seasons [2021, 2022] only, D094's grid, mode/shrinkage adopted from D094 unchanged

time_window_table: all games in the same season on STRICTLY EARLIER DATES (date-blocked, so same-day games are excluded)
the whole previous season; seasons are calendar-disjoint, asserted by assert_season_disjoint
the whole frame; FIRES ONLY on rows with neither an earlier same-season game nor a previous season in the frame; counted and reported as grand_fallback_rows
NOT prior-only -- named, counted, and never in an evaluation set
the player's own same-season games at an EARLIER position in the date-sorted group; prefix arrays indexed at h, never h+1
tuned EWMA of the player's prior games
half-life / mode / shrinkage (pts, minutes, fga, ppm)
D094's grid, selected on 2022-2023 and evaluated on 2023-2024; imported, not re-searched
selected inside this screen on TRAIN SEASONS ONLY, frozen and hashed before any re-priced figure
the player's own PREVIOUS season, whole; calendar-disjoint
each is a rung or a prior-only aggregate above
OLS fitted on seasons STRICTLY EARLIER than the season being scored; the earliest season is unscored
refitted on seasons strictly earlier than the scored season, matching D089/D098's walk-forward protocol
computed on the realised response of the FULL scored row set; uses the response only, never a forecast, and is identical across every arm of a comparison
uses realised y of the scored set -- as every R2 denominator must; identical across arms

leads.quoted_what: walk-forward paired points dR2 of P01_c04_prevgame over B_COMPLETE (refB_ppm, refB_spm, refB_pps, refB_mpg, refB_own_usg_pg), DECISION stratum, n=4517
leads.why: the feature column and the response are both frozen in the screen's own frame; only the REFERENCE changes

leads.quoted_what: pooled defence main effect on the full DECISION stratum (n=4514) against B_COMPLETE, common denominator
leads.frame: E1_I0018 screen_frame joined to E0_I0016 screen_frame for A10_opp_defrtg
leads.why: same construction as D089 with a different feature column

leads.quoted_what: pooled points SKILL (1 - MAE ratio) of the operating rule against D076's reference, which the same screen showed to be partly degenerate
leads.why: the quoted number IS a reference comparison; substituting the rung is the whole operation

leads.quoted_what: end-to-end walk-forward dR2 on RESTRICTED-AREA ATTEMPT COUNTS
leads.why_not: the response is a ZONE-LEVEL attempt count.  The ladder defines a rung for TOTAL attempts (fga), not for attempts within a shot zone, and the lead's base is a five-zone system of forecasts.  Re-pricing it means rebuilding the zone forecasts, i.e. re-running the pipeline.  SKIPPED PER THE BRIEF rather than approximated by substituting total FGA, which would be a different quantity wearing the same name.

leads.quoted_what: walk-forward plain-OLS dR2 on TURNOVERS PER 100 OFFENSIVE POSSESSIONS
leads.why_not: the response is a team-pressure RATE that is not one of the six ladder targets, and its base is a fitted multi-term pressure model rather than a reference forecast.  There is no rung to re-price it onto without defining a seventh target and re-running the whole screen.  SKIPPED PER THE BRIEF.

denominator_rule: Two dR2 figures are comparable only if ALL of the following hold.
D1 SAME RESPONSE: the same variable in the same units.  No rescaling makes a dR2 on turnover-rate comparable to a dR2 on points (D072 ruling 4).
D2 SAME SCORED ROWS: the identical row set, not merely the same n.

D3 SAME DENOMINATOR: SST computed on that full scored row set about ITS OWN unweighted mean.  A subset's SST is never a valid denominator for a figure that will be compared to a stratum-wide figure (D099: a ~4x inflation).
D4 SAME WEIGHTING in all three of the fit, the SSE and the SST (D072 ruling 2).
D5 SAME BASE: both increments measured over the same reference model (D090, D094).

If D2 fails but D1/D4/D5 hold, the figures become comparable after BOTH are re-expressed on a common denominator: dR2_common = SSE_reduction / SST_common, SST_common being the SST of the common scored row set.  If D1 fails, they are NOT comparable and no denominator fixes it.
plan.what_would_count_as_the_ranking_changing: The leads that share the POINTS response (D089, D099, D092) are ranked by their re-priced figure on the canonical rung and a common denominator.  THE RANKING CHANGES if any pair swaps order relative to the order implied by the currently quoted figures.  This is declared BEFORE the figures are computed.  A rank swap means every prioritisation decision taken on the quoted numbers rested on an artefact; no swap means the reference problem is a REPORTING problem, not a DECISION problem.  Both answers are reportable and neither is the preferred outcome.
plan.nulls: Correct-level only.  Paired cluster sign-flip at (season, player) for forecast comparisons; SCHEME_WITHIN_CYCLIC for prior-history regressors (D093: the plain within-player shuffle is anticonservative and the kit now refuses it).  Row-level nulls are computed FOR CONTRAST ONLY and always reported beside the correct one.
plan.no_champion_fitting: The champion is never refitted.  Only its stored forecast columns are scored.
